messages:
laura: Heads-up — preparing release notes draft for v0.23 docs push tomorrow morning. Putting things I'm unsure about in this thread: SDK snippet accuracy, known-issues list, and the migration guide links. Draft: https://docs.redwood.inference/release-notes/v0.23-draft

mike: on it. which PR contains the final snippets? :eyes:

laura: PR #642 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/642). The Java SDK example was rewritten, not confident about the streaming snippet changes.

jess: I reviewed the Java snippet — small rename bug. Change `RedwoodClient.stream().start(...)` to `RedwoodClient.streaming().start(...)`. I'll push a tiny PR.

sam: re: known issues — we should surface the Dedicated cold-start regression (ticket INF-981). Short blurb + workaround: set `min_instances: 1` in dedicated config.

laura: good call. suggestion for the blurb? short sentence please.

sam: "Known issue: Dedicated pools may experience longer cold-starts (~5-10s) after scale-to-zero. Workaround: configure min_instances > 0 to keep warm capacity. Tracking: INF-981." — that's my draft.

olivia: Also flag the SDK breaking change in embeddings API (parameter `vector` -> `embedding_vector`). Many customers already updated but we should add a note and link to the migration guide.

laura: I'll add a migration link. Where is that doc? PR or page?

jess: https://docs.redwood.inference/migrations/embeddings-param-rename (PR #610). It has examples for JS/Python/Java.

laura: perfect. One more: the JS snippet for streaming currently shows `await client.createStream(...)` but our SDK uses event emitter pattern now. Example should be:

```
const stream = client.streaming.create();
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
stream.start({ model: 'kitefish-1' });
```

mike: agreed. I'll update the snippet in the release notes and push before 11pm PT.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs build will run on PR merge. If you need a preview link, comment `@docs-bot preview` on the PR.

laura: thanks. Last item — links sweep: there are two 404s in the draft (embed migration and dedicated config examples). I fixed the link to dedicated config but couldn't find the old embed migration anchor.

sam: I can add an anchor to the migration page. Will open PR to add `#parameter-rename` anchor.

laura: awesome. Can we get a quick sanity check on the final markdown? I'll post the PR when ready. Target merge: 1763500200 (tomorrow 8am PT). Ping if you need edits.

mike: pinged in PR, left one nit on wording. :pencil:

jess: LGTM once the Java rename is fixed. :thumbsup:

olivia: added the embeddings note to the top-level changelog as "breaking change (SDK)".

laura: thank you all — I'll merge after fixes and trigger the docs deploy. If anyone sees something in the preview, comment in the PR. :rocket:
